summary: Phase A MLB Monte Carlo Simulator end-to-end verified. All 6 pytest cases pass (sim schema, non-MLB 404, backtest structure, math sanity). Frontend SimulatorPanel renders correctly on MLB pick detail (showing 88.2% ±0.5% · 10k runs · STRONGER vs MODEL +5.6) and is correctly hidden on Tennis pick detail. No crashes on other panels. No deprecated expo packages detected in changed files. One minor console warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) — pre-existing, unrelated to this phase.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Not in sim files; unrelated to Phase A but worth tracking.

critical_code_review_comments: sim_runner.apply_simulations mutates picks in-place and stores sim_lock_lift only when |lift| >= 0.1 — looks correct; lift is bounded by SIM_LIFT_MAX=4 (matches the ±4 spec).
sim_mlb.simulate_mlb_pick uses random module (not numpy) at 10k iterations — runtime is ~50–80ms per pick which is fine for on-demand endpoint, acceptable for refresh slate.
Backtest endpoint correctly returns {n:0, message, days} when no settled picks with sim_wp exist — matches frontend api.simBacktest type union.
